stem.en: A compound microscope's objective lens gives a magnification of 10, and its eyepiece gives a further magnification of 5. What is the total magnification?
stem.et: Liitmikroskoobi objektiivläätse suurendus on 10 ja selle okulaar annab veel 5-kordse suurenduse. Milline on kogusuurendus?

label.en: 50, since the two lenses' magnifications multiply in a compound instrument
label.et: 50, sest kahe läätse suurendused korrutuvad liitseadmes

label.en: 15, since the two magnifications simply add together
10, since only the objective lens determines total magnification
5, since only the eyepiece determines total magnification
